_doc: FOOTER-CONTACT-AND-UNIVERSAL-COVERAGE-W1 — the declared exemption set for the brand-footer
injector (scripts/inject-footer.mjs) and the coverage gate that pairs with it.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the injector used to carry a hand-maintained TARGETS array. It went
stale TWICE — OPS-INTEGRATIONS-VENUE-PAGES-W1 records the first (gemini/kraken/alpaca never
received the footer), and this wave found the second (12 of 24 integrations pages listed).
Targets are now DERIVED from a glob, so the only thing a human maintains is the far smaller
set of pages that must NOT get a footer — and each of those carries its reason in DATA.
An exemption that lives only in a code comment gets 'fixed' by a future wave enforcing the
contract; one that lives here has to be argued with.

exempt.reason: HTML FRAGMENT — carries no <html> or </body>. It is injected INTO other pages, so a footer here would nest inside the host page's body and render a second time.
